text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate detected on inference-prod -> /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. 5xx spike to ~15% for last 3m, latency tail rising. Paging @oncall.

emma (oncall): on it — I'm seeing 5xx + 504s from the edge gateways. Grafana: spike started at 2026-03-14T20:12:00Z. Traces point to Envoy upstream 503/504s, not application 4xx.

sophie (eng-sre): joining. checking LB health and recent config pushes (envoy-control). Anyone who changed routes in the last hour?

raj (eng-runtime): I didn't push anything in the last 2h. Tailing gateway logs now (shipping logs show lots of 502/503 from cluster:inference-backend).

olga (support): multiple customers flagged errors via the API — some high-volume customers seeing dropped requests. I've escalated to CS leads and added a note to the internal incident tracker.

kevin (prodops): hypothesis: a recent route config increased retries and removed per_try_timeout -> causing retry storms and backend overload. If gateways keep retrying, backends hit connection limits and return 5xx. Suggest we temporarily disable retries at the edge and widen circuit breaker ejection.

emma (oncall): agree. I'll apply emergency change: set retry policy to zero and bump max connections/circuit-breaker thresholds down on effected routes, plus enable outlier detection. Preparing a config snippet to push via envoy-control: 

```yaml
route:
  retry_policy:
    num_retries: 0
  per_connection_buffer_limit_bytes: 1048576
circuit_breakers:
  default:
    max_connections: 200
    max_pending_requests: 100
outlier_detection:
  consecutive_5xx: 3
  interval: 10s
  base_ejection_time: 30s
```

emma (oncall): executing /deploy envoy-config --change emergency-disable-retries --target gateways-prod 

incident-bot: config change accepted (change_id: ec-20260314-1). Rolling to 3 gateway clusters.

sophie (eng-sre): applied change to 3 edge clusters, verifying metrics. Watch the 5xx rate in the next 2m.

raj (eng-runtime): after the change I'm seeing 5xx drop from 15% -> ~3.5% within 90s. Good signal. Still seeing some 502s from one backend pool (inference-a), looks like connections saturated earlier and some requests still queue.

kevin (prodops): suggestion: also reduce retry_on flags (eg: remove retry_on: gateway-error, 5xx) if present in any route-level overrides. Those amplify failures.

emma (oncall): checking overrides... found one route for /v1/embeddings with: retry_on: 5xx, num_retries: 3, per_try_timeout: null — that explains prolonged waits. I'll patch that route to per_try_timeout: 3s and num_retries: 0.

raj (eng-runtime): nice catch. That route was part of yesterday's canary where a quick rollback missed the route-level config. The backend cluster had lower capacity. Recommend we also enable upstream drain and slow-start to smooth traffic.

emma (oncall): applying per-route fix now. snippet: 

```yaml
route_match: "/v1/embeddings"
route_action:
  retry_policy:
    num_retries: 0
    per_try_timeout: 3s
  request_mirror_policy: null
```

incident-bot: change ec-20260314-2 applied to route /v1/embeddings.

sophie (eng-sre): monitoring: 5xx now down to 0.7% cluster-wide, p95 latency back to normal ranges. Backend pool inference-a still showing elevated connection resets but trending down.

olga (support): posting update to status page: "We are investigating elevated errors affecting inference endpoints. Mitigation in progress. Some customers may experience transient errors. Updates every 15 minutes." status-bot posted incident id INC-20260314-45.

kevin (prodops): follow-up: we should rollback the canary change that added route-level retry-on=5xx to avoid recurrence. Also add a preflight check in the config CI to block retry_on: 5xx without per_try_timeout.

raj (eng-runtime): agreed. Preparing a small patch for config-validator: enforce per_try_timeout <= 5s when num_retries > 0. Will PR to infra-config in a few minutes.

emma (oncall): I'm going to hand off monitoring to raj for the next 3 hours while I take the next incident rotation break. Please keep me looped if errors creep above 1%.

raj (eng-runtime): taking over monitoring. I'll keep alerts muted at lower threshold for a bit to avoid flapping, but will escalate if 5xx > 1% sustained or error budget hit.

sophie (eng-sre): leaving a note for postmortem: root cause = route-level retry policy (num_retries > 0) without per_try_timeout + permissive circuit breaker thresholds. That combination caused retry amplification and connection saturation on inference-a -> 5xx storm. Mitigation = disabled retries, set per_try_timeout, tighten circuit breakers, enable outlier ejection.

olga (support): compiling customer impact list (10 customers with >100 errors each). Will coordinate post-incident comms.

status-bot: Status update posted to public page and internal tracker. Next automated update scheduled in 15 minutes.

emma (oncall): closing active mitigation. Leaving the thread open for postmortem notes and followups. Thanks everyone for quick response :thumbsup:
